mr_title: Optimize ObjectNode findValue(s) and findParent(s) fast paths

expected_issues.title: findValues/findParents stop at the first direct match and skip sibling subtrees
expected_issues.description:
The fast path returns as soon as a direct child matches, so findValues/findValuesAsText/findParents no longer collect matches located in sibling subtrees.

The original loop visited every entry: a matching key was collected and other entries were recursed into. The optimised version looks up `_children.get(propertyName)` and returns immediately when it exists, so for `{"a":1, "b":{"a":2}}` findValues("a") now returns [1] instead of [1, 2]. The same early return was introduced in findValuesAsText and findParents. This silently changes the documented result of a public API in a change presented as a pure optimisation.

expected_issues.title: Optimisation of a public API ships without tests of nested matches
expected_issues.description: findValue(s)/findParent(s) are rewritten for speed without any test; a test with the same property name at several nesting levels would have shown the lost sibling matches.
